idea-plugin.name: Rememberable
idea-plugin.description:
IDE support for the Rememberable Kotlin compiler plugin.

Resolves @Rememberable generated Saver properties in K2 mode, eliminating false "Unresolved reference" errors in the editor.

Requires the Rememberable Gradle plugin to be applied in your project. See GitHub for setup instructions.
idea-plugin.change-notes: • Initial release — K2 FIR extension support for IDE analysis
